verdict.rationale: BILL's own docs show S&E virtual cards can be created and managed, including via the API with budgets and users (docs-2, docs-69), and the marketing says every card transaction is 'controlled' (docs-9). Nothing documents locking a card to a single merchant or vendor, or using dedicated per-subscription cards, so the core isolation promise is unproven. AP-side virtual card disbursement to vendors (docs-65) is a payment method, not a vendor-locked spend card, and gets no credit here. Missing for 10: documented merchant/vendor locking per card, per-subscription card controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
